reason: The pattern strongly supports a cubic a≈9.42 Å cell and the average anti-Th3P4 framework, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied (the report says unavailable), and the claimed ≈4.3% value is a custom integrated-intensity metric after a coarse manual coordinate scan, not a whole-profile refinement. More importantly, all three CIFs are convenient ordered Nd/Sm subgroups with essentially identical strong diffraction, while the trajectory enumerated 1,820 Nd placements but instantiated only one representative from three symmetry classes and did not compare the many remaining Cc, P2221, C2, R3, P21, P2, and P1 realizations. An exact-composition reference also provides a materially different I-43d mixed-occupancy average model. Thus the cell/framework are credible, but the submitted symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, and element ordering are underdetermined, so another solution attempt is warranted.
